question: Use `test/qa/ledger_loop_invariant_probe_test.py` and execute the full parametrized test suite in that file (all cases). Inside `yt_dlp/ledger_walk.py`, function `ledger_walk`, consider the `for i, ch in enumerate(token):` loop and its local variable `checksum`. At the start of each loop iteration `i` (immediately before executing the assignment `checksum = (checksum + ord(ch)) % 256`), must it always be true that `checksum == (sum(ord(token[j]) for j in range(i)) % 256)` (with the empty sum defined as `0` when `i == 0`)? Answer as `loop_invariant_holds` (boolean): `true` only if this predicate holds at the start of every iteration for every call to `ledger_walk` in the suite.
